theme: 全真模擬考 第 5 回

words.ex: You can withdraw from a course before week four.
Always cite your sources in a research paper.
The committee will evaluate each application.
The concert coincides with the debate final.
The workshop is open to all, regardless of major.
A donation from a former student paid for the printers.
The library extended its hours during finals.
Send me a one-page outline by the end of the month.
Bees play a key role in pollination.
Bring a copy of your transcript to the workshop.

audio.t: When does the campus pool open on weekends?

options: Yes, I swim there every weekend.
At eight in the morning, I think.
questions.explain: 問句以 When 詢問開放時間，(B) 回答「早上八點」最合適。(A) 用 Yes 回答 Wh- 問句不合邏輯；(C) 回答地點，答非所問。

audio.t: Could you lend me your notes from yesterday's history class?

options: Sure, I'll send you a photo of them tonight.
The class was in room three oh two.
I borrowed it from the library.
questions.explain: 對方請求借筆記，(A) 答應並說今晚傳照片，最自然。(B) 回答教室位置；(C) 重複 borrow／lend 相關字但內容無關。

audio.t: Why was the career talk canceled?

questions.explain: Why 問原因，(C) 講者班機延誤是合理原因。(A) 回答地點；(B) 用 Yes 回答 Why 問句，且重複 cancel 製造干擾。

audio.t: Have you finished the reading for Thursday's seminar?

options: Only the first chapter so far.
The seminar room is on the third floor.
I think the reading lamp is broken.
questions.explain: 問是否讀完指定閱讀，(A)「目前只讀了第一章」直接回應進度。(B) 談研討室位置；(C) 利用 reading 一字（reading lamp 檯燈）造成混淆。

audio.t: Who's in charge of booking the bus for the field trip?

options: The bus fare is fifty dollars.
questions.explain: Who 問負責人，(C) 林教授的助理負責，回答了「人」。(A) 回答時間；(B) 重複 bus，回答車資，皆不符。

audio.t: Would you prefer to meet in the library or the student lounge?

options: The lounge is fine, since we can talk there.
I met him in the library.
questions.explain: 選擇疑問句要從兩者擇一，(B) 選學生交誼廳並說明理由。(A) 選擇疑問句不能用 Yes 回答；(C) 時態與對象都不對。

audio.t: Isn't the deadline for the scholarship application this Friday?

options: I applied for a part-time job.
No, it was extended to next Monday.
questions.explain: 否定疑問句在確認截止日，(C) 說明已延到下週一，直接回應。(A) 重複 apply 但談打工；(B) 重複 Friday 但與截止日無關。

audio.t: How long does it take to get a new student I D card?

questions.explain: How long 問所需時間，(A) 約三個工作天。(B) 回答費用（How much）；(C) 回答地點（Where）。

audio.t: I can't find my locker key anywhere.

options: The locker room closes at ten.
Did you check the pocket of your jacket?
I'll lock the door when I leave.
questions.explain: 對方說找不到鑰匙，(B) 建議看看外套口袋，是合理回應。(A) 重複 locker 但談關門時間；(C) lock 與 locker 音近，屬聲音干擾。

audio.t: Where should I put these returned books?

options: On the cart next to the front desk.
questions.explain: Where 問地點，(C) 放在服務台旁的推車上。(A) 談到期日；(B) 重複 book 但答非所問。

audio.t: Why don't we ask the T A to explain the formula again?

options: Good idea. Let's email her after class.
Because the formula was on the exam.
The T A is a graduate student.
questions.explain: Why don't we...? 是提出建議，(A) 表示贊同並提出行動最恰當。(B) 誤把它當成問原因而用 Because 回答；(C) 只描述助教身分。

audio.t: Did you sign up for the volunteer program or the language exchange?

options: Neither. I'm too busy this semester.
questions.explain: 二選一的問句，(B)「兩個都沒有，這學期太忙」是合理回答。(A) 用 Yes 回答選擇問句且 sign 意思不同；(C) 只重複 program。

audio.t: Hi, my bike chain came off. Is the repair station still open?
The station by the main gate closes at five, but the one behind the sports center is open until seven thirty.
It's already five fifteen, so I'll go to the one behind the sports center then.
Remember to bring your bike registration sticker. They only help registered bikes.

questions.prompt: Where will the man most likely go?
questions.explain: 大門旁的維修站五點就關，現在已五點十五分，男子說要去體育館後面那一站，故選 (C)。(A) 已關門；(D) 只提到要帶登記貼紙，並非要去登記處。

audio.t: Attention, swimmers. Because of a problem with the heating system, the indoor pool will be closed from Wednesday to Friday this week. The outdoor pool remains open, but the water may be cold. Swimming classes scheduled for these days will be made up next week.

questions.prompt: Why will the indoor pool be closed?
options: The heating system has a problem.
The water is too cold for classes.
questions.explain: 廣播開頭即說因暖氣（加熱）系統故障而關閉室內池，選 (A)。(B) 水冷指的是戶外池；(C) 課程是延到下週補課，不是原因。

audio.t: Did you know the north dining hall now stays open until eleven at night?
Really? Since when?
Since last Monday. But after nine, they only serve sandwiches and noodles, not full meals.
That's still great for people studying late.

questions.prompt: What can students get at the north dining hall after nine p.m.?
questions.explain: 女子說九點之後只供應三明治和麵，不供應正餐，選 (D)。(A) 正好被否定；(B)(C) 對話未提及。

audio.t: Hi, Jason, this is Rachel from the chemistry department office. Our records show you haven't completed the lab safety training yet. You can't enter the lab next week without it. The online course takes about forty minutes, and you must score at least eighty percent on the final quiz. Please finish it by Sunday.

questions.prompt: What must Jason do by Sunday?
options: Enter the lab for the first time
Take a quiz with his classmates
questions.explain: 留言要求 Jason 週日前完成線上實驗室安全課程，選 (B)。(C) 進實驗室是下週、且前提是完成訓練；(D) 測驗是課程的一部分，沒說要和同學一起考。

audio.t: Before you leave, a reminder about the reading response. Instead of submitting it on paper, please upload it to the course website by midnight Thursday. Late uploads will lose ten percent per day.

questions.prompt: How should students hand in the reading response?
options: Give it to the professor in class
Email it to the teaching assistant
questions.explain: 教授說不要交紙本，改上傳到課程網站，選 (A)。(B) 紙本繳交正是被取代的方式；(C) 未提到寄給助教。

audio.t: Could you not play music after midnight? I have an eight a.m. class every day this week.
Sorry, I didn't realize it was that loud. I'll use my headphones from now on.
Thanks. And if you need to make calls late, the study lounge downstairs is open all night.

questions.prompt: What will the man do from now on?
questions.explain: 男子說從現在起會戴耳機，選 (C)。(A)(B) 是女子對深夜講電話的建議，男子未答應；(D) 早上八點的課是女子的。

audio.t: The course registration system crashed again this morning. Did you get into the statistics class?
No, but the department said they'll reopen registration at ten tonight and add twenty more seats.
Then let's both set an alarm.

questions.prompt: What will happen at ten tonight?
options: The department will announce the class schedule.
Registration will open again with more seats.
The statistics class will be canceled.
questions.explain: 系上表示今晚十點重新開放選課並增加二十個名額，選 (B)。(A)(C) 對話中都沒有提到。

audio.t: Thank you for your interest in the student ambassador program. Ambassadors lead campus tours for high school visitors, mostly on Saturday mornings. You'll receive a small payment for each tour and a certificate at the end of the year. Training sessions are held in the first two weeks of March, and attendance is required.

questions.prompt: What is required of new ambassadors?
questions.explain: 最後一句說三月前兩週的訓練必須出席（attendance is required），選 (D)。(A) 導覽主要在週六早上；(B) 反而是有酬勞；(C) 證書是年底發給大使的。

audio.t: I left my student card at home. Can I still borrow these two books?
I'm afraid not. But I can hold them for you at the desk until closing time tomorrow.
Perfect. I'll come back tomorrow afternoon.

questions.prompt: What will the man do?
options: Keep the books for the woman
questions.explain: 館員說可以把書保留在櫃台到明天閉館，選 (A)。(B) 他已拒絕現在借出；(C) 未提及補辦學生證。

audio.t: Hello, this is Mister Huang from the scholarship committee. Your interview has been moved from Tuesday to Wednesday at the same time, two o'clock, because one of the interviewers is ill. It will now take place in room three fifteen of the administration building, instead of room three fifty. Please call us back if this time doesn't work.

questions.prompt: Where will the interview take place?
questions.explain: 留言說面試改在行政大樓 three fifteen（315）室，選 (D)。(A) 350 是原本的教室；(B)(C) 是數字相近的干擾。

audio.t: Are you joining the department relay race on sports day?
I'd like to, but I hurt my ankle playing basketball last week.
That's too bad. Maybe you could help keep time for the races instead?
Sure. That's something I can do while sitting down.

questions.prompt: What will the man probably do on sports day?
options: See a doctor about his ankle
questions.explain: 男子腳踝受傷不能跑，答應改當計時人員，選 (B)。(A) 因受傷無法參加；(C) 打籃球是上週受傷的原因；(D) 未提及。

audio.t: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to the first session of our exam stress workshop. I'm Linda Kuo, a counselor at the Student Counseling Center.
Over the next hour, we'll look at why stress rises before final exams and what you can do about it.
First, a little stress is actually useful. It keeps you alert and helps you focus. The problem begins when stress stops you from sleeping or eating well.

One method we recommend is called the two list method. Every evening, write one list of tasks you must finish the next day, and another list of the worries on your mind. Writing the worries down helps your brain let go of them.
Another tip is to study in short blocks of about forty minutes, followed by a ten minute break away from your screen.
Today's session is the first of three. Next Tuesday we'll practice breathing exercises, and the final session will focus on sleep.
If you'd like to talk to a counselor one on one, you can book an appointment online. Appointments are free for all registered students, and everything you say is kept private.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker say about a small amount of stress?
options: It should be avoided before exams.
It is a sign of poor planning.
It can help students stay focused.
questions.explain: 講者說少量壓力其實有用，能讓人保持警覺、幫助專注，選 (D)。(A) 與講者觀點相反；(B) 影響睡眠的是過度壓力，不是少量壓力；(C) 未提及。

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the second list in the two-list method?
options: To write down worries so the mind can let go of them
To plan tasks for the following week
To record how long each study block takes
To list questions for the counselor
questions.explain: 第二張清單寫下心中的煩惱，寫下來能幫助大腦放下，選 (A)。(B) 第一張清單是隔天（不是下週）要做的事；(C) 四十分鐘讀書區塊是另一個建議；(D) 未提及。

questions.prompt: Which TWO things are true about one-on-one appointments? (Choose TWO.)
options: They are free for registered students.
They must be booked by phone.
They focus only on sleep problems.
questions.explain: 最後一段說個別諮詢對註冊學生免費，且談話內容保密，故選 (A)(C)。(B) 週二是下一次工作坊；(D) 是線上預約不是電話；(E) 睡眠是第三次工作坊主題。

audio.t: Come in, Wei-jie. You emailed me about your term paper?
Yes, Professor Chang. I wanted to write about how social media affects voting among young people, but I'm finding too many sources. I don't know where to start.
That's a common problem. Your topic is too broad. Why not focus on one platform and one election? For example, how first time voters used video apps during last year's city election.
That sounds much more manageable. But will there be enough data?
The university's political science center ran a survey of first time voters last year. You can request the results through the department office. It usually takes about a week.
Great. And the paper is due on December tenth, right?
Yes, but I'd like a one page outline from you by the end of this month, so I can give you feedback before you start writing.
Okay. I'll send it by the thirtieth.

questions.prompt: What is the student's main problem?
options: He missed the deadline for his paper.
He disagrees with the professor's feedback.
questions.explain: 學生說資料太多不知從何下手，教授指出題目太廣，選 (B)。(C) 正好相反，是資料太多；(A) 截止日是十二月十日，尚未錯過；(D) 學生同意教授建議。

questions.prompt: How can the student get survey data?
options: By downloading it from a video app
By requesting it through the department office
questions.explain: 教授說可以透過系辦申請政治學中心的調查結果，選 (C)。(B) 影音 app 是研究主題，不是資料來源；(A)(D) 未提及。

questions.prompt: What will the student send the professor by the end of the month?
options: The first draft of his paper
questions.explain: 教授要求月底前交一頁大綱，學生答應三十號前寄出，選 (A)。(B) 正式報告十二月十日才交；(C) 調查結果是學生向系辦申請的。

audio.t: This is Campus Express with your weekly update. Our top story: the university has launched a new mobile app called My Campus.

The app brings together several services that used to be on different websites. Students can check their class schedules, see real time shuttle bus locations, and reserve study rooms, all in one place.
One of the most popular features so far is the cafeteria menu, which shows the daily specials and how crowded each dining hall is at the moment.
However, some students have complained that the app drains their phone battery quickly. The I T Center says an update fixing this problem will be released next week.
Paying for printing through the app is not yet possible, but it is planned for next semester.
The app is free and can be downloaded from the university website. To log in, use your student number and your email password.

questions.prompt: Which TWO services are available in the new app? (Choose TWO.)
questions.explain: 報導提到可查課表、看接駁車即時位置、預約讀書室，故選 (B)(D)。(A) 列印付費要到下學期才有；(C)(E) 未提及。

questions.prompt: What problem have some students reported?
options: The app is difficult to download.
The cafeteria menu is out of date.
They cannot log in with their student number.
The app uses too much battery.
questions.explain: 有學生抱怨 app 很快耗盡手機電量（drains their phone battery），選 (D)。(B) 菜單功能反而最受歡迎；(A)(C) 下載與登入只是說明方式，並非抱怨。

questions.prompt: When will students be able to pay for printing through the app?
options: At the end of this month
questions.explain: 報導說列印付費功能預計下學期推出，選 (B)。(A) 下週推出的是修正耗電的更新。

audio.t: Today we're going to talk about pollination, and in particular, about bees.
About one third of the food we eat depends on animals that carry pollen from one flower to another. Bees are the most important of these animals.
Many people think only of honeybees, the ones farmers keep in boxes. But there are actually more than twenty thousand species of bees in the world, and most of them live alone, not in large groups.
Some of these wild bees are even better pollinators than honeybees. For example, certain bees shake flowers to release pollen, which helps plants such as tomatoes.
Unfortunately, the number of bees has been falling in many countries. The main reasons are the loss of wild flowers, the use of chemicals on farms, and changes in climate.
Cities can help. Planting native flowers on rooftops and in parks gives bees food and places to live.
For next week, I'd like you to walk around campus and count how many kinds of flowering plants you can find. Bring your list to class, because we'll use it for a group discussion.

questions.prompt: According to the lecture, what is true about most bee species?
options: They are kept by farmers in boxes.
They live alone rather than in groups.
questions.explain: 教授說世界上兩萬多種蜜蜂中，大多數是獨居而非群居，選 (C)。(A) 指的只是蜜蜂（honeybees）；(B) 番茄只是舉例；(D) 未提及。

questions.prompt: Which is NOT mentioned as a reason for the fall in bee numbers?
questions.explain: 蜜蜂減少的原因是野花消失、農藥化學物質、氣候變遷，即 (B)(C)(D)；屋頂種花反而是城市能幫忙的方法，故 NOT 題選 (A)。

questions.prompt: What should students do before the next class?
options: Count the kinds of flowering plants on campus
questions.explain: 作業是在校園走一圈，計算能找到幾種開花植物，選 (D)。(A) 種原生花是城市的做法，不是作業；(B)(C) 未提及。

questions.prompt: Students who wish to ______ from the course must do so before the end of the fourth week.
questions.explain: withdraw from a course 是「退選課程」的固定用法，選 (C)。attend 是出席（不接 from）；remove 是及物動詞，需接受詞；retreat 指撤退，不用於選課。

questions.prompt: The library has ______ its opening hours during the final exam period, so it now closes at two a.m.
questions.explain: 延長開放時間用 extend，選 (A)。exceed 超過、express 表達、expose 暴露，字形相近但意思不合。

questions.prompt: All participants must wear safety glasses ______ they are working in the lab.
questions.explain: 「只要在實驗室工作就必須戴護目鏡」，用 whenever（每當），選 (D)。unless（除非）邏輯相反；although 表讓步不合；despite 是介系詞，後面不能接子句。

questions.prompt: The professor asked us to ______ our sources carefully, so that readers can find the original articles.
questions.explain: cite sources 是「註明引用來源」，讓讀者找得到原文，選 (B)。recite 是背誦、excite 是使興奮，皆為音近干擾；describe 描述不符目的。

questions.prompt: The committee will ______ each application based on the student's grades and a short essay.
questions.explain: 委員會依成績與短文「評估」申請，用 evaluate，選 (B)。elevate 提升、evacuate 撤離、estimate 估計（數量），皆不合。

questions.prompt: Freshmen are ______ to attend the orientation; those who miss it must make an appointment with their advisor.
questions.explain: 後半句說缺席者必須另約導師，可知新生「必須」參加，be required to，選 (D)。forbidden／prevented 意思相反；delayed 不合語意。

questions.prompt: The new dormitory is ______ located, only a five-minute walk from both the library and the main cafeteria.
questions.explain: 距圖書館與餐廳都只要走五分鐘，表示「位置便利」，conveniently located，選 (A)。comfortably 舒適地、constantly 不斷地、carefully 小心地，皆不搭配 located。

questions.prompt: Because the two events ______, students will have to choose between the concert and the debate final.
questions.explain: 兩個活動「時間撞期」才需二選一，coincide，選 (C)。compete（競爭）字形相近但不表示時間重疊；complete、collect 意思不合。

questions.prompt: Thanks to a generous ______ from a former student, the art department was able to buy new printers.
questions.explain: a generous donation from... 「一筆慷慨的捐款」，選 (D)。donor 是捐贈「人」，不能說 a donor from a former student 來買印表機；dominance、doctrine 意思不合。

questions.prompt: If you are not ______ with your grade, you may ask the instructor to review your exam.
questions.explain: 人「感到滿意」用過去分詞 satisfied，be satisfied with，選 (B)。satisfying 是「令人滿意的」；satisfaction 是名詞；satisfy 是原形動詞。

questions.prompt: The workshop is open to all students, ______ of their major.
questions.explain: regardless of 「不論、不管」為固定片語，選 (C)。regarding 意為「關於」，後面不接 of；regarded、regard 詞性不合。

questions.prompt: The student union plans to ______ a survey to find out what students think about the new meal plan.
questions.explain: carry out a survey「進行調查」，配合目的「了解學生想法」，選 (A)。give up 放棄、put off 延後、turn down 拒絕，都與目的矛盾。

reading.title: Notice: New Bicycle Parking Rules
passage: Starting January 6, bicycles may only be parked in marked areas on campus. Bicycles left outside these areas, including those locked to trees, railings, or stair handrails, will be removed by campus security and taken to the storage yard next to the East Gate.
To get a removed bicycle back, owners must show their student ID and pay a fee of NT$200 at the Security Office within 30 days. Bicycles not collected after 30 days will be donated to charity.
A map of all marked parking areas is available on the Security Office website. Two new parking areas, with space for 300 bicycles, have been added near the Engineering Building and the library.

questions.prompt: What will happen to a bicycle locked to a stair handrail?
options: It will be taken to a storage yard.
Its owner will receive a warning letter.
It will be moved to a marked area.
questions.explain: 第一段說停在畫線區外（包括鎖在樓梯扶手上）的腳踏車會被移到東門旁的保管場，選 (B)。(A) 要超過 30 天未領才捐出；(C)(D) 文中未提。

questions.prompt: What must owners do to get back a removed bicycle?
options: Download a map from the website
Visit the storage yard within one week
Register it at the Engineering Building
Show ID and pay a fee at the Security Office
questions.explain: 第二段說須出示學生證並在 30 天內到駐警隊繳 200 元，選 (D)。(B) 期限是 30 天而非一週；(A) 地圖是查停車區用；(C) 工程館旁是新增停車區。

reading.title: Change of Meeting Date
head: From: Dr. Helen Wu <hwu@univ.edu>
To: Senior Project Students
Subject: Change of meeting date
passage: Dear all,

I need to reschedule our group meeting this week because I will be attending a conference in Tokyo. Instead of Thursday afternoon, we will meet on Monday, November 24, from 10:00 to 12:00 in my office, Room 508.

Please bring a printed copy of your literature review, not your full draft. Each of you will have about ten minutes to explain your main sources and ask questions. If you cannot attend, send me your literature review by email before Sunday night, and we will arrange a short online meeting.
Best regards,
Helen Wu

questions.prompt: Why is the meeting being moved?
options: Dr. Wu will be at a conference.
Students need more time for their drafts.
questions.explain: 信中說因為要去東京參加研討會，所以改期，選 (A)。(B) 508 是新的開會地點；(C)(D) 文中未提。

questions.prompt: What should a student who cannot attend do?
options: Bring a printed copy to Room 508 later
Email the literature review before Sunday night
Ask another student to explain his or her sources
questions.explain: 無法出席者要在週日晚上前寄文獻回顧，再安排線上短會，選 (C)。(B) 老師明說不要完整草稿；(A)(D) 未提及。

reading.title: Text Messages
passage: Sophie (9:12 a.m.): Hi Ken! Are you still flying home on Friday? My flight is at 6:40 p.m. too.
Ken (9:15 a.m.): Yes! Want to share a taxi to the airport? It's about NT$1,200, so it'd be half each.
Sophie (9:16 a.m.): Sounds good. But wouldn't the airport bus be cheaper? It's only NT$140.
Ken (9:18 a.m.): True, but I have two big suitcases, and the bus stop is a 15-minute walk from our dorm.
Sophie (9:20 a.m.): Fair point. Let's take a taxi then. Can we leave at 3:30? I have a class until 3:00.
Ken (9:21 a.m.): Perfect. I'll book it now. Meet you at the dorm entrance.

questions.prompt: How much will Sophie probably pay for the trip?
questions.explain: 計程車約 1,200 元、兩人各付一半，Sophie 最後同意搭計程車，所以付 600 元，選 (D)。(A) 是公車票價；(B) 是車資總額；(C) 是兩張公車票的干擾數字。

questions.prompt: Why does Ken prefer a taxi?
options: His flight leaves early in the morning.
The taxi is cheaper than the bus.
questions.explain: Ken 說他有兩個大行李箱，且公車站要走 15 分鐘，選 (B)。(D) 相反，公車較便宜；(C) 班機是傍晚 6:40；(A) 未提。

reading.title: Room Change Request Form
passage: Name: Lin Pei-chun    Student No.: B11203045
Current room: Willow Hall, Room 712
Preferred room type: ( ) Single   (X) Double   ( ) Quad
Preferred building: (X) Any   ( ) Willow Hall only
Reason for request: My current roommate and I have very different schedules. She works night shifts and returns at 2 a.m., while I have 8 a.m. classes four days a week.

Notes: Requests are processed in the order received. A fee of NT$500 is charged once a new room is assigned. Students will be notified by email within two weeks. Requests submitted after December 15 will be considered for the spring semester.

questions.prompt: Why does Pei-chun want to change rooms?
options: Her room is too far from her classes.
She and her roommate keep different hours.
She wants to stay in Willow Hall.
questions.explain: 申請理由是室友上夜班凌晨兩點回來，而她早上八點有課，作息不同，選 (C)。(A) 她勾選的是雙人房；(D) 她勾選任何大樓皆可；(B) 未提。

questions.prompt: What is true about the request process?
options: A fee is paid only after a new room is given.
Students are told the result by phone.
Requests are processed by grade level.
All requests are handled in the spring semester.
questions.explain: 備註說分配到新房間後才收 500 元，選 (A)。(B) 是以 email 通知；(C) 是依收件順序處理；(D) 只有 12 月 15 日後送件的才延到春季學期。

reading.title: Campus Radio Is Looking for New Hosts
passage: Do you enjoy music, news, or simply talking? Campus Radio 88.5 is looking for five new hosts for the spring semester.

Hosts will present a one-hour weekly program and choose its topic, from local music to campus news. No experience is needed, as all new hosts will receive four hours of training in January. However, you must be able to work on the program every week for the whole semester.

To apply, send a two-minute recording of yourself talking about any topic, along with a short description of your program idea, to radio@univ.edu by December 20. Interviews will be held in the first week of January.

questions.prompt: What is NOT required of applicants?
options: A description of a program idea
questions.explain: 廣告說 No experience is needed，不需要經驗，NOT 題選 (B)。(A)(C) 是申請要寄的資料；(D) 文中說必須整學期每週都能主持。

questions.prompt: When will applicants be interviewed?
options: In the last week of the spring semester
In the first week of January
questions.explain: 最後一句說面試在一月第一週舉行，選 (D)。(A) 12 月 20 日是報名截止；(B) 訓練是錄取後才有。

reading.title: Library's 24-Hour Study Zone Returns for Finals
passage: Last spring, the university library tried something new: during the two weeks of final exams, the first floor stayed open 24 hours a day. The trial was so successful that the library has decided to repeat it this semester, starting December 29.

According to library director Paul Shih, more than 6,000 students used the space between midnight and 6 a.m. during the trial. "We expected students to come late at night, but we were surprised by how many came early in the morning, before their 8 a.m. exams," he said.

Not everything went smoothly. Some students complained about noise, as groups discussing assignments disturbed those who wanted to study silently. This time, the library will divide the floor into two areas: a silent zone near the windows and a discussion zone near the entrance. Security staff will also check student IDs at the door after 10 p.m., since several non-students were found sleeping in the library last spring.
Food will still not be allowed, but drinks in covered cups are permitted. A vending machine selling snacks will be placed outside the main entrance.

questions.prompt: Why is the library opening 24 hours again?
options: The trial last spring was successful.
Students asked for longer hours all year.
The library is being renovated in spring.
More exams have been scheduled at 8 a.m.
questions.explain: 第一段說去年春天的試辦非常成功，所以決定這學期再辦，選 (A)。(B)(C) 未提及；(D) 8 點考試是館長提到學生清晨來的原因，不是再開放的理由。

questions.prompt: What surprised the library director?
options: Students came to sleep in the library.
Many students came early in the morning.
questions.explain: 館長說預期學生會深夜來，但驚訝於很多人清晨、在早上八點考試前來，選 (C)。(B) 與六千多人使用的事實相反；(A) 睡在館內的是非學生；(D) 未提。

questions.prompt: What change will be made to deal with noise?
options: Groups will be asked to leave after 10 p.m.
The floor will be divided into two areas.
Security staff will check student IDs.
Discussion will only be allowed outside.
questions.explain: 為解決噪音，樓層將分為靜音區與討論區，選 (B)。(C) 查證件是為了防止非學生入館睡覺，不是處理噪音；(A)(D) 未提及。

questions.prompt: Which of the following is allowed inside the study zone?
questions.explain: 最後一段說食物仍不准帶入，但有蓋杯子的飲料可以，選 (D)。(A) 販賣機設在門外，零食屬食物不准帶入；(B) 也是食物；(C) 文中提到有人睡在館內是問題。

reading.title: Learning to Cook in a Shared Dorm Kitchen
passage: When I moved into the dormitory in my second year, I had never cooked anything more complicated than instant noodles. In my first year, I had eaten every meal at the cafeteria, but after my meal plan ended, I realized I was spending almost half of my monthly budget on food.

Our floor has a small shared kitchen with two stoves and one refrigerator for thirty students. At first, it was frustrating. The fridge was always full, and someone often "borrowed" my eggs. I almost gave up after a week.

Things changed when a senior named Andrea suggested starting a cooking group. Five of us agreed to take turns cooking dinner on weekdays, so each person only had to cook once a week. We shared the cost of ingredients, which turned out to be much cheaper than buying meals alone. Andrea, who had grown up helping in her parents' restaurant, taught us simple dishes like fried rice and tomato egg soup.

Now, a year later, I can cook about fifteen dishes, and my food spending has dropped by about forty percent. More importantly, the cooking group became my closest group of friends. If you are living in a dorm, my advice is simple: don't cook alone.

questions.prompt: Why did the writer start cooking?
options: A senior asked for help in the kitchen.
The dorm required students to cook.
questions.explain: 第一段說餐券方案結束後，發現伙食費幾乎占每月預算一半，所以開始自己煮，選 (C)。(A) 餐廳沒有關閉；(B) 學姊是後來提議組烹飪團；(D) 未提。

questions.prompt: What problem did the writer face in the shared kitchen at first?
options: Food was taken by other people.
The kitchen was closed on weekdays.
questions.explain: 第二段說冰箱總是滿的，常有人「借走」作者的蛋，選 (A)。(B) 只說有兩個爐子，沒說壞掉；(C)(D) 文中未提。

questions.prompt: How often did each member of the cooking group cook dinner?
questions.explain: 五人輪流煮平日晚餐，每人一週只需煮一次，選 (D)。(A) 是整個團體吃晚餐的頻率，不是每個人負責煮的次數。

questions.prompt: What is the writer's main advice?
options: Eat at the cafeteria in the first year
Keep your food in your own room
questions.explain: 結尾建議 don't cook alone，也就是和別人一起煮，選 (B)。(C) 學姊家開餐廳只是背景細節；(A)(D) 都不是作者的建議。

reading.title: Career Center Spring Workshop Series
passage: The Career Center is pleased to announce its spring workshop series. All workshops are free for current students, and recent graduates (within two years of graduation) may join for a fee of NT$300 per workshop.

Registration opens on February 20 through the Career Center website. Because places are limited, please register only for workshops you are sure you can attend. Students who register but do not show up twice will not be able to sign up for workshops for the rest of the semester.

Lunchtime workshops include a free light lunch, so please register at least three days in advance to help us order food. For the evening workshop on interview skills, participants will take part in mock interviews in small groups; please wear clothing you would wear to a real interview.

The link for the online workshop will be sent by email one day before the session. Students interested in the workshop on internships abroad should also bring a copy of their transcript, as advisers will check which programs they qualify for.

questions.prompt: Who must pay to attend a workshop?
options: Graduates who finished school within two years
questions.explain: 第一段說在校生免費，畢業兩年內的校友每場需付 300 元，選 (B)。(A) 缺席兩次的懲罰是不能再報名，不是付費；(C)(D) 未提。

questions.prompt: Which workshop has the fewest places available?
questions.explain: 由表格名額欄可知 Interview Skills Practice 只有 20 人，最少，選 (D)。(B) 30 人；(A) 40 人；(C) 100 人。

questions.prompt: A student wants to attend the workshop on March 4. By what date should the student register?
questions.explain: 圖文整合：表格顯示 3 月 4 日是 12:10 的午餐時段工作坊，文章第三段說午餐工作坊須至少提前三天報名，故最晚 3 月 1 日，選 (A)。(C) 2 月 20 日是開放報名日；(D) 只提前一天。

questions.prompt: What should students bring to the workshop held on March 27?
questions.explain: 圖文整合：表格顯示 3 月 27 日是 Finding Internships Abroad，文章最後一段說參加此場要帶成績單影本，選 (C)。(B) 正式服裝是模擬面試那場的要求；(D) 連結是線上場次用 email 寄送。

questions.prompt: What will happen to students who register but miss two workshops?
options: They cannot register for more workshops this semester.
They will be put on a waiting list.
They must meet with an adviser.
questions.explain: 第二段說報名卻兩次未到者，本學期不能再報名工作坊，選 (B)。(A) 300 元是校友費用；(C)(D) 未提及。
